name: Abuse From A Spouse
overview: Scripture warns believers to avoid the path of wickedness and contention within the home, recognizing that strife and harsh words only escalate anger and division. The Lord deeply values the covenant of marriage, expressing His hatred for treachery and violence disguised under the guise of putting away a spouse. God calls His people to guard their spirits, reject contentiousness, and pursue peace, for such behavior not only disrupts the household but also grieves the heart of the Lord.
